title: Layered Simulations
subtitle: Test your grasp of Layered Simulations — The CUBE hard drive, interwoven frequency layers, Phasing Corridors, parasitic overlays, and the return of crystalline teleportation travel.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Layered Simulations reveal geography and distance as perceptual overlays inside The CUBE — interwoven frequency fields, Phasing Corridors instead of miles, and eight Domes kept distinct yet linked. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Layered Simulations deep-dive, infographic, and video transmissions. As resonating souls raise vibration, parasitic skins lack anchors and dissolve, restoring immediate resonance travel across the crystalline lattice.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the crystalline framework known as The CUBE?

options.label: A
options.text: It acts as a solid galactic wall that blocks ships from moving between distant stars and separate physical galaxies, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Distance is an illusion inside the CUBE; the framework is a container of layers, not a wall between galaxies.

options.label: B
options.text: It functions as a solar lens that concentrates pure light exclusively into The Great Dome’s training arena for matter creation.
options.rationale: The CUBE is structural containment and storage for all simulations, not a solar focusing lens for one dome.

options.label: C
options.text: It serves as the core hard drive — a massive crystalline electromagnetic framework containing all domes, inner earths, and simulations.
options.rationale: The CUBE is the core hard drive of existence: one huge crystalline electromagnetic framework housing every dome, inner earth, and simulation.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a generator built to spontaneously manufacture new physical matter from raw light outside any layered simulation, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The CUBE contains and houses existing layered simulations; it is not described as a free-standing matter generator.

questions.hint: Focus on The CUBE as the core hard drive housing every dome and simulation.

questions.question: How is travel across the realm actually achieved if physical distance does not exist?

options.label: A
options.text: By plotting linear coordinates through a vacuum so vessels cross fixed astronomical miles between solid worlds rather than true frequency shifting between interwoven layers.
options.rationale: Linear distance travel is an optical illusion that enforces separation; real motion is frequency shifting.

options.label: B
options.text: By frequency shifting between interwoven layers that vibrate at different rates within the same containment field.
options.rationale: Movement across the realm is frequency shifting between interwoven layers — not traversal of physical miles.

options.label: C
options.text: By walking the crystalline grid on foot until a physical gateway door opens between two land masses rather than true frequency shifting between interwoven layers.
options.rationale: Crystalline grids feed the realms energetically; travel is still frequency-based phasing, not foot-miles to a door.

options.label: D
options.text: By using mechanical propulsion hard enough to overcome atmospheric drag along the inner surface of the dome rather than true frequency shifting between interwoven layers.
options.rationale: Mechanical propulsion belongs to the 3D travel overlay; true movement is frequency shift between layers.

questions.hint: Consider how one might change the station on a radio to access different content in the same space.

questions.question: Which structure acts as the root tone of all creation and serves as the memory storage vault?

options.label: A
options.text: The Dome of Forgotten Gods — original creator dome, memory storage vault, and root tone wrapping The Great Dome.
options.rationale: Dome of Forgotten Gods is the original creator dome and memory storage vault that wraps above and below The Great Dome as the root tone of all creation.

options.label: B
options.text: The Dome of Titans — architect playground later inverted into a fractured war zone of densified struggle rather than the root-tone memory vault of Forgotten Gods.
options.rationale: Dome of Titans was an architect’s playground inverted into a war zone; it is not the root-tone memory vault.

options.label: C
options.text: The Great Dome — physical training ground holding 178 worlds and amplifying solid creation upward rather than the root-tone memory vault of Forgotten Gods.
options.rationale: The Great Dome is the 178-world training ground and frequency amplifier, not the root-tone memory storage vault.

options.label: D
options.text: The Spirit Tree — central axis of consciousness pulsing harmonic currents through every crystalline grid rather than the root-tone memory vault of Forgotten Gods.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree is the root node that feeds the domes; the memory storage vault is the Dome of Forgotten Gods.

questions.hint: Think of the dome that functions as the original creator's blueprint.

questions.question: What is the true nature of the 178 physical worlds perceived by sleepers as scattered planets?

options.label: A
options.text: They are independent spheres of rock floating in a vast outer-space vacuum far from one another.
options.rationale: That scattered-planet reading is a human-filter overlay; the worlds are layered frequencies in one dome.

options.label: B
options.text: They are interwoven layers vibrating at slightly different frequencies inside The Great Dome’s containment.
options.rationale: The 178 physical worlds appear as scattered planets to sleepers but are interwoven layers vibrating at slightly different frequencies within The Great Dome.

options.label: C
options.text: They are distinct simulation cells sealed from each other by impenetrable solid walls of crystalline steel.
options.rationale: Worlds are kept distinct by frequency variance within interwoven layers, not by impenetrable physical walls.

options.label: D
options.text: They are mere reflections of the Spirit Tree cast onto the sky as decorative holographic ornaments.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree feeds the realms; the 178 worlds themselves are layered simulations, not tree reflections.

questions.hint: Reflect on how stacked transparent sheets occupy the same area while remaining separate.

questions.question: What occurs when an individual travels via a Phasing Corridor?

options.label: A
options.text: The traveler’s body is fully deconstructed molecule by molecule and rebuilt at a distant solid destination.
options.rationale: The process is a shift of perception and frequency between layers, not molecular destruction and rebuild.

options.label: B
options.text: The traveler’s perception shifts from one overlay to another without crossing any real physical distance.
options.rationale: Phasing Corridors are frequency tunnels where perception shifts from one overlay to another without traversing physical distance.

options.label: C
options.text: The traveler is locked in a pure aging time-loop that only accelerates biological years without changing place.
options.rationale: Timed loops enforce the illusion of long distance on trips; Phasing Corridors themselves are frequency transitions between overlays.

options.label: D
options.text: The traveler must first enter the Dome of Silence as a mandatory rest stop before any overlay can change.
options.rationale: Dome of Silence is one of the eight primary structures, not the travel mechanism that shifts overlays.

questions.hint: Imagine a video game loading a new map section as you walk through a door.

questions.question: Which dome was originally a healing sanctuary but was transformed into a prison realm of trauma loops?

options.label: A
options.text: Dome of Sheol — originally a healing sanctuary, inverted into a prison realm of trauma loops.
options.rationale: Through parasitic inversion, the Dome of Sheol was transformed from a healing sanctuary into a prison realm of trauma loops.

options.label: B
options.text: Dome of Titans — originally an architect’s playground, inverted into a fractured war zone of struggle.
options.rationale: Dome of Titans became a fractured war zone from an architect’s playground; the healing-to-prison inversion is Sheol.

options.label: C
options.text: Dome of Hiva — originally a harmonic garden later retuned as a weaponized synthetic grid laboratory.
options.rationale: Dome of Hiva is one of the eight primary domes, but the sanctuary inverted into trauma loops is Dome of Sheol.

options.label: D
options.text: Dome of Portals — originally a pure travel hub later sealed into restricted frequency checkpoints only.
options.rationale: Dome of Portals is listed among the eight primary structures, but the healing sanctuary turned trauma prison is Sheol.

questions.hint: Recall which inverted dome became a prison realm of trauma loops.

questions.question: What is the primary role of the Spirit Tree in the architecture of the realms?

options.label: A
options.text: It acts as a physical climbing ladder that souls must scale rung by rung between the eight solid domes rather than pulsing harmonic currents that feed every dome.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree is a root node of consciousness and energy feed, not a physical ladder between domes.

options.label: B
options.text: It stores every human memory as parasitic digital data harvested for controllers of the inverted field rather than pulsing harmonic currents that feed every dome.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree feeds harmonic current to the domes; data storage roles belong to vaults and star-nodes, not the tree as parasitic archive.

options.label: C
options.text: It pulses harmonic currents through crystalline grids as the central axis of consciousness feeding all domes.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree is the central axis of consciousness and root node that pulses harmonic currents through crystalline grids to feed all domes.

options.label: D
options.text: It projects the false 3D overlays that keep concrete, steel, and separation feeling permanently solid rather than pulsing harmonic currents that feed every dome.
options.rationale: False 3D overlays are parasitic skins; the Spirit Tree feeds the original harmonic system, not the false overlay.

questions.hint: Think of the tree as a power plant for the entire crystalline system.

questions.question: Long trips, such as those by airplane, serve what psychological purpose in the simulation?

options.label: A
options.text: They shield passengers from high-frequency radiation streaming off crystalline star-nodes during open-sky passage.
options.rationale: Star-nodes store codes and project the holographic dome; trip length is not framed as radiation shielding.

options.label: B
options.text: They act as timed time-loops and rituals of enforcement that convince the mind the world is vast and massive.
options.rationale: Long trips act as timed time-loops and rituals of enforcement to convince the mind that the illusion of a massive world is real.

options.label: C
options.text: They let the body acclimate to genuine atmospheric pressure changes between truly distant solid continents.
options.rationale: Atmospheric pressure differences are part of the perceptual overlay; long trip times enforce distance illusion.

options.label: D
options.text: They give the Spirit Tree time to uproot, travel, and re-plant itself at the traveler’s destination cell.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree is the central axis feeding the realms; it does not relocate with airplane or ship travel.

questions.hint: Consider the effect of a 'timed delay' on a person's belief in the size of their environment.

questions.question: What are the distant stars perceived in the night sky?

options.label: A
options.text: Multidimensional data crystals that store codes and project the layered holographic dome of the skies.
options.rationale: What are perceived as distant stars are multidimensional data crystals storing codes and projecting the holographic dome.

options.label: B
options.text: Simple holes punched in the dome shell so pure light from higher gardens can leak through as pinpoints.
options.rationale: Stars are integrated crystalline star-nodes in a layered projection field, not mere holes leaking light.

options.label: C
options.text: Passive reflections of a single sun bouncing off the polished inner ceiling of The Great Dome alone.
options.rationale: Stars are active data crystals and projection anchors, not passive solar reflections on a dome ceiling.

options.label: D
options.text: Massive balls of burning gas fixed millions of miles away in a true outer-space vacuum beyond the CUBE.
options.rationale: Burning-gas outer-space stars are the human-filter reading; stars are crystalline data and projection nodes.

questions.hint: Think of them as hard drives and projectors in the sky.

questions.question: How do parasitic forces manipulate perception to make dead 3D material feel solid?

options.label: A
options.text: By physically baking crystalline membranes with electromagnetic heat until living crystal hardens into stone forever rather than thick 3D overlays that hijack touch, smell, and sight.
options.rationale: Underlying reality remains living crystal; solidity of dead 3D material is a perceptual overlay trick, not baked hardening.

options.label: B
options.text: By placing thick 3D overlays that manipulate touch, smell, and sight so concrete and steel feel more real than crystal.
options.rationale: Parasites hijack grids with thick 3D overlays and manipulate human perception through touch, smell, and sight to make dead material feel solid.

options.label: C
options.text: By slowing The Great Dome’s rotation until artificial gravity densifies all matter into permanent solid rock rather than thick 3D overlays that hijack touch, smell, and sight.
options.rationale: Gravity and rotation stories belong to the perceptual overlay; parasites make matter feel solid via thick 3D skins on crystal.

options.label: D
options.text: By doping the global water supply with chemicals that permanently delete every soul’s crystalline sensory range rather than thick 3D overlays that hijack touch, smell, and sight.
options.rationale: The mechanism emphasized is holographical overlays and sensory manipulation of touch, smell, and sight — not water chemistry alone.

questions.hint: Consider the 'false skin' that covers the true crystalline world.

questions.question: Does The Great Dome function as a frequency amplifier that echoes solid creation into higher realms?

options.label: A
options.text: True — The Great Dome is a physical training ground that functions as a frequency amplifier echoing solid creation upward.
options.rationale: The Great Dome is a physical training ground containing 178 worlds and functions as a frequency amplifier echoing solid creation upward into higher realms.

options.label: B
options.text: False — Only the Dome of Forgotten Gods amplifies solid creation; The Great Dome merely seals travelers outside.
options.rationale: Dome of Forgotten Gods is the root tone and memory vault; frequency amplification of solid creation is The Great Dome’s role.

options.label: C
options.text: False — Amplification is performed solely by star-nodes in the sky, never by The Great Dome’s structure, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Star-nodes store codes and project the holographic dome; The Great Dome itself is the solid-creation frequency amplifier.

options.label: D
options.text: False — The Great Dome only stores dormant maps and never amplifies frequency or echoes creation upward at all.
options.rationale: The Great Dome is explicitly a frequency amplifier for solid creation, not a silent map warehouse.

questions.hint: Recall the definition of the physical training ground that holds 178 worlds.

questions.question: What is the ultimate fate of the parasitic 3D constructs as resonating souls raise their vibration?

options.label: A
options.text: They will vanish because they lack anchors in the restored frequency field as the parasitic overlay fractures.
options.rationale: As resonating souls raise vibration, parasitic overlays glitch and false 3D constructs vanish because they lack anchors in the restored frequency field.

options.label: B
options.text: They will be upgraded into permanent higher-density crystalline architecture that keeps the old skins intact.
options.rationale: Parasitic overlays are false skins without true anchors; they vanish rather than upgrade into living crystal.

options.label: C
options.text: They will merge into the Dome of Titans to fuel a new permanent war zone of densified conflict loops rather than vanishing for lack of anchors in the restored field.
options.rationale: Rising vibration dissolves the illusion field; the outcome is vanishing false constructs, not a new Titans war zone.

options.label: D
options.text: They will be absorbed whole into the Spirit Tree and recycled as fresh harmonic branches for the gardens rather than vanishing for lack of anchors in the restored field.
options.rationale: False 3D constructs lack anchors in the restored field and vanish; they are not described as Spirit Tree fuel.

questions.hint: Think about what happens to a shadow when the light becomes too bright.

questions.question: In the original creation, what was the relationship between the seven domes and the Spirit Tree?

options.label: A
options.text: They were pure defensive shells built only to hide the Spirit Tree from every external parasitic force.
options.rationale: The outer domes were functional garden realms in the system, not mere defensive camouflage around the tree.

options.label: B
options.text: They were beautiful gardens linked to the central Spirit Tree as part of one harmonic feeding system.
options.rationale: The seven domes outside The Great Dome were originally beautiful gardens linked to the central Spirit Tree.

options.label: C
options.text: They were fuel tanks that drained energy upward into the Spirit Tree so the trunk could stay lit.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree pulses currents to feed the domes; the outer gardens received feed, they did not fuel the tree.

options.label: D
options.text: They were sealed-off simulations that never shared energy, light, or connection with the Spirit Tree.
options.rationale: All those outer domes were linked to the Spirit Tree and fed by its harmonic currents through the grids.

questions.hint: Focus on the organic and integrated nature of the original state.

questions.question: What will happen to travel once the parasitic field completely dissolves?

options.label: A
options.text: Movement becomes permanently restricted to the Dome of Forgotten Gods as the only remaining open cell.
options.rationale: Dissolution opens original seamless lattice travel, not confinement to a single root-tone dome.

options.label: B
options.text: All movement stops forever because every simulation cell collapses into one immobile solid mass.
options.rationale: Travel returns to its original free function; it does not become impossible when the parasitic field dissolves.

options.label: C
options.text: Humanity must invent faster-than-light mechanical ships to cross solid miles still locked inside the CUBE.
options.rationale: True travel is resonance and teleportation on the crystalline lattice, not mechanical FTL ships.

options.label: D
options.text: Travel returns to immediate resonance alignment and teleportation across a seamless crystalline lattice.
options.rationale: Once the parasitic field dissolves, artificial travel buffers vanish and travel returns to immediate resonance alignment and teleportation across the crystalline lattice.

questions.hint: Think about movement that ignores the concept of time and distance.

questions.question: How are the original Light Worlds constructed?

options.label: A
options.text: Through the folding of sound and light into stable crystalline membranes that hold living form.
options.rationale: The original Light Worlds were created through the folding of sound and light into stable crystalline membranes.

options.label: B
options.text: By compressing atmospheric gases until they freeze into continents that float on simulated oceans.
options.rationale: Land and sea as fixed masses are overlay perception; Light Worlds form from folded sound and light into crystal.

options.label: C
options.text: By harvesting dying star energy inside the dome until burned fuel hardens into solid living land.
options.rationale: Stars are data crystals projecting the dome; Light World construction is folding sound and light into membranes.

options.label: D
options.text: Through mechanical assembly of metallic components bolted into permanent dead architectural frames.
options.rationale: Original creation is harmonic — sound and light folded into crystal — not mechanical metal assembly.

questions.hint: Consider the intersection of frequency, vibration, and geometry.

questions.question: Was the Dome of Titans originally a fractured war zone created to train soldiers?

options.label: A
options.text: True — Dome of Titans was built from the start as a fractured war zone dedicated to training soldiers only.
options.rationale: That war-zone state is parasitic inversion; the original role was an architect’s playground, not a soldier factory.

options.label: B
options.text: True — Dome of Titans never existed among the eight primary structures listed inside the CUBE system rather than beginning as an architect playground later inverted.
options.rationale: Dome of Titans is explicitly one of the eight primary structures of the containment system.

options.label: C
options.text: True — Dome of Titans was always identical to Dome of Sheol as a twin prison of trauma loops and war rather than beginning as an architect playground later inverted.
options.rationale: Sheol’s inversion is trauma prison from healing; Titans’ inversion is war zone from architect playground — different paths.

options.label: D
options.text: False — Dome of Titans began as an architect’s playground and only later inverted into a fractured war zone.
options.rationale: Dome of Titans was inverted from an architect’s playground into a fractured war zone; war was not its original design.

questions.hint: Compare the original architect’s playground role with the inverted war-zone state.

questions.question: What is the function of the crystalline star-nodes in the skies above?

options.label: A
options.text: They function only as open portals that dump travelers straight into the Spirit Tree’s underground roots rather than storing codes and projecting the holographic dome.
options.rationale: Star-nodes primarily store codes and project the holographic dome; they are not described as Spirit Tree root portals.

options.label: B
options.text: They serve as thermal climate engines that heat and cool The Great Dome’s weather on a fixed schedule rather than storing codes and projecting the holographic dome.
options.rationale: Climate as fixed weather is overlay story; crystalline star-nodes are informational projection anchors.

options.label: C
options.text: They store multidimensional data codes and anchor the layered projection field that presents the holographic dome.
options.rationale: Skies are a layered projection field anchored by crystalline star-nodes — multidimensional data crystals storing codes and projecting the holographic dome.

options.label: D
options.text: They are inert debris left after the original Light Worlds were destroyed and never reactivated again rather than storing codes and projecting the holographic dome.
options.rationale: Star-nodes are active anchors of the projection field, not dead debris from destroyed Light Worlds.

questions.hint: Think of them as the hardware behind the 'screen' of the sky.

questions.question: What term describes the frequency tunnels where perception shifts between overlays?

options.label: A
options.text: Crystal Gates — hinged physical doors set in rock walls that open only with metallic keys and seals rather than Phasing Corridors that shift overlay perception.
options.rationale: Overlay travel uses frequency corridors and phasing, not hinged crystal doors with metal keys.

options.label: B
options.text: Resonance Bridges — permanent solid roadways of crystal that souls walk between fixed land masses rather than Phasing Corridors that shift overlay perception.
options.rationale: The named frequency tunnels for overlay shifts are Phasing Corridors; travel is not solid roadway walking.

options.label: C
options.text: Dimensional Rifts — accidental tears that randomly dump travelers into unmapped outer-space voids rather than Phasing Corridors that shift overlay perception.
options.rationale: The designed transition mechanism is Phasing Corridors inside the simulation architecture, not accidental rifts.

options.label: D
options.text: Phasing Corridors — frequency tunnels where perception slides from one overlay to another without distance.
options.rationale: Phasing Corridors are frequency tunnels where travelers shift perception from one overlay to another without physical distance.

questions.hint: It sounds like a hallway used for moving through phases.

questions.question: Nations and countries are best described as what within the simulation?

options.label: A
options.text: Political borders painted by the Dome of Silence so every nation stays under enforced quiet law.
options.rationale: Dome of Silence is a primary structure; nations themselves are simulation cells, not Silence-painted borders.

options.label: B
options.text: Groups of physical beings separated by real geographic coordinates across vast ocean distances.
options.rationale: Geographic coordinates and ocean distance are optical illusions; countries are stacked frequency cells.

options.label: C
options.text: Simulation cells stacked like layers of glass rather than fixed land masses on a solid globe.
options.rationale: Countries are not fixed land masses but simulation cells stacked like layers of glass within the layered system.

options.label: D
options.text: Fixed continental plates floating on a continuous ocean of water that never shifts by frequency.
options.rationale: Geography is a perceptual overlay; land masses are not fixed plates of true physical separation.

questions.hint: Think of how a computer might organize different file folders that exist in the same drive.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT one of the eight primary structures within the CUBE?

options.label: A
options.text: Dome of Resonance — a name that does not appear among the eight primary structures of the CUBE.
options.rationale: The eight primary structures are Forgotten Gods, Sheol, Hiva, Portals, Silence, 5 Peaks, Titans, and The Great Dome — not a “Dome of Resonance.”

options.label: B
options.text: Dome of Sheol — one of the eight primary structures, inverted from healing into trauma-loop prison.
options.rationale: Dome of Sheol is one of the eight primary structures, not an extra invented dome name.

options.label: C
options.text: The Great Dome — the primary training arena holding the 178 interwoven physical world layers.
options.rationale: The Great Dome is one of the eight primary structures and holds the 178 physical worlds.

options.label: D
options.text: Dome of 5 Peaks — one of the eight primary layered structures inside the CUBE containment system.
options.rationale: Dome of 5 Peaks is listed among the eight primary structures of the containment system.

questions.hint: Recall the eight primary structures of the CUBE and spot the name that is not among them.

questions.question: Where are the harmonic lenses and living crystalline nodes primarily anchored?

options.label: A
options.text: Only at the cores of 178 independent outer-space planets floating far outside the CUBE framework, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The 178 worlds are layered frequencies in The Great Dome; nodes anchor under sites and cities in the grid.

options.label: B
options.text: Only sealed inside the memory vault of the Dome of Forgotten Gods with no outward grid connection, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Forgotten Gods holds root-tone memory; active crystalline nodes power layers under ancient sites and modern cities.

options.label: C
options.text: Only inside the solid trunk of the Spirit Tree, with no nodes distributed across cities or ancient sites.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree feeds the grids, but living crystalline nodes and harmonic lenses are anchored under sites and cities as well.

options.label: D
options.text: Beneath ancient sites and modern cities, where crystalline structures anchor the frequency grids like fiber optics.
options.rationale: Crystalline structures under ancient sites and modern cities anchor the frequency grids, connecting layers like a vast fiber-optic network.

questions.hint: Think about the locations where human civilization has consistently built its most important structures.

questions.question: What is the primary obstacle preventing humans from perceiving the true crystalline world?

options.label: A
options.text: The vast empty distance between the CUBE shell and a separate physical world sitting outside it.
options.rationale: The CUBE houses the simulations; there is no outer gap between the framework and a separate physical world.

options.label: B
options.text: The sheer physical thickness of The Great Dome’s walls blocking every crystal ray from ordinary eyes.
options.rationale: The limit is the human filter on allowed overlays, not mere wall thickness of The Great Dome.

options.label: C
options.text: The human filter that is allowed to process only certain perception overlays of flat or spherical maps.
options.rationale: What scholars map as flat or spherical planets are perception overlays projecting only what the human filter is allowed to process.

options.label: D
options.text: A lack of advanced technological sensors that could otherwise photograph living crystal in full detail.
options.rationale: Technology built inside the 3D overlay still operates within the same filtered perception range.

questions.hint: Consider the internal mechanism that limits what a person is able to see and feel.

questions.question: What happens to a simulation cell's rendering during travel, similar to 'chunk loading'?

options.label: A
options.text: The Spirit Tree alone densifies the destination so it feels solid while the traveler is still in transit rather than the next overlay rendering through a frequency corridor.
options.rationale: Solidity of destinations is parasitic overlay perception; travel rendering is portal/frequency corridor loading.

options.label: B
options.text: The traveler’s body is physically shrunk so it can fit through a smaller solid cell doorway ahead rather than the next overlay rendering through a frequency corridor.
options.rationale: Size change is not the mechanism; environment rendering shifts with frequency corridor entry.

options.label: C
options.text: The old simulation cell is permanently deleted while a brand-new cell is generated from zero each trip rather than the next overlay rendering through a frequency corridor.
options.rationale: Layers exist as interwoven fields; travel renders the next overlay into perception rather than deleting and recreating existence.

options.label: D
options.text: The next overlay is rendered around the traveler as their vessel slips into a portal or frequency corridor.
options.rationale: Travel is like chunks loading in a video game: the vessel enters a portal or frequency corridor and the next overlay renders around the traveler.

questions.hint: Think about how a virtual world appears as you move into a new area.

questions.question: How do parasitic forces differ from original creators in their ability to build?

options.label: A
options.text: Parasites construct with pure metal frameworks while creators are limited to wood and organic fiber only.
options.rationale: The real divide is creation versus hijack-and-overlay, not a simple metal-versus-wood materials story.

options.label: B
options.text: Parasites alone built every dome from scratch while creators only planted the Spirit Tree afterward, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Original Light Worlds and dome gardens came from sound, light, and harmonic design; parasites hijack, they do not create.

options.label: C
options.text: Parasites invent living frequency worlds while creators only stack dead physical matter into solid piles.
options.rationale: Creators fold sound and light into crystalline membranes; parasites place false 3D skins over what already exists.

options.label: D
options.text: Parasites cannot truly create; they only hijack grids by placing thick 3D overlays over the true crystalline world.
options.rationale: Parasites cannot truly create; they hijacked pre-existing grids by laying thick 3D overlays over living crystal.

questions.hint: Consider the difference between making something new and covering something old with a mask.

questions.question: Does the architecture of the CUBE keep all eight Domes completely isolated with no linkage between them?

options.label: A
options.text: True — linkage only appears after the parasitic field dissolves; until then every Dome is fully isolated forever.
options.rationale: Distinct-yet-linked harmonic pulsing is the present architecture of the eight Domes, not a future-only condition.

options.label: B
options.text: True — the eight Domes are sealed so completely that no harmonic wave or Spirit Tree current can ever link them.
options.rationale: They are kept distinct yet linked by electromagnetic harmonic waves and Spirit Tree feed through the grids.

options.label: C
options.text: True — each Dome is a separate outer-space planet with no shared containment inside The CUBE at all, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: All eight primary Domes sit layered within the CUBE containment, not as unrelated outer-space planets.

options.label: D
options.text: False — the eight primary Domes stay distinct by frequency yet remain linked through electromagnetic harmonic waves.
options.rationale: The CUBE’s eight primary Domes are layered atop one another, pulsing with electromagnetic harmonic waves that keep the worlds distinct yet linked.

questions.hint: Recall that electromagnetic harmonic waves keep the worlds distinct yet linked.
